description: This file implements MD5 hashing functions for the Linux kernel, including initialization, update, finalization, and hardware interfacing for MD5 encryption within the Data Encryption Unit (DEU) driver for Infineon Technologies' UEIP project.

methods.name: md5_transform
methods.description: Main interface to MD5 hardware, processes a 64-byte input block to update the hash state.

methods.name: md5_transform_helper
methods.description: Helper function that calls md5_transform with current context.

methods.name: md5_update
methods.description: Processes input data on-the-fly, updating the MD5 hash context.

methods.name: md5_final
methods.description: Computes the final MD5 hash value and resets the context.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_md5
methods.description: Registers the MD5 hashing algorithm with the Linux crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_md5
methods.description: Unregisters the MD5 hashing algorithm from the Linux crypto API.
